import fs from 'node:fs'
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'

const KIT = '/data/claude/webkit/packages/webkit/docs/reviews/m2.7/battery-2-kit'
const pages = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${KIT}/pages.eval.json`, 'utf8'))
const S = pages.filter((p) => p.surface === 'site').map((p) => p.id)
const C = pages.filter((p) => p.surface === 'console').map((p) => p.id)
const groups = {
  S1: S.slice(0, 11),
  S2: S.slice(11, 22),
  S3: S.slice(22, 34),
  S4: S.slice(34),
  C1: C.slice(0, 10),
  C2: C.slice(10)
}
const ports = { S1: 5101, S2: 5102, S3: 5103, S4: 5104, C1: 5111, C2: 5112 }
for (const [j, list] of Object.entries(groups)) {
  const d = `/data/eval-m27b/jobs/${j}`
  fs.mkdirSync(`${d}/ref/tiles`, { recursive: true })
  fs.mkdirSync(`${d}/pkgs`, { recursive: true })
  const sub = pages
    .filter((p) => list.includes(p.id))
    .map((p) => ({ ...p, screenshots: { desktop: `ref/${p.id}--desktop.png`, iphone: `ref/${p.id}--iphone.png` } }))
  fs.writeFileSync(`${d}/pages.json`, JSON.stringify(sub, null, 1))
  for (const id of list)
    for (const v of ['desktop', 'iphone'])
      fs.copyFileSync(`/data/eval-m27b/ref/shots/${id}--${v}.png`, `${d}/ref/${id}--${v}.png`)
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync('/data/eval-m27b/pkgs')) fs.copyFileSync(`/data/eval-m27b/pkgs/${f}`, `${d}/pkgs/${f}`)
  execFileSync('/data/eval-m27b/venv/bin/python', [
    '/data/eval-m27b/bin/tile.py',
    `${d}/ref/tiles`,
    ...list.flatMap((id) => [`${d}/ref/${id}--desktop.png`, `${d}/ref/${id}--iphone.png`])
  ])
  fs.writeFileSync(
    `${d}/job.json`,
    JSON.stringify({ job: j, port: ports[j], surface: j[0] === 'S' ? 'site' : 'console', pages: list }, null, 1)
  )
  console.log(j, list.length, list.join(' '))
}
